scope: Live triage, source capture, quote verification, fact ranking, signal writing and local email rendering. No publication or email send. This is one representative story, not a full daily-issue quality evaluation.

triaged.title: (PR) AMD Introduces Its Next Ryzen AI Halo Developer Platform With Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495
triaged.angle: Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 platform supports up to 192 GB unified memory and 300-billion-parameter models locally.

triaged.title: NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB Price Hikes Put Entry-Level GPU Above $1,200 in Japan
triaged.angle: Japanese retailer listings put the RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB above $1,200.

triaged.title: (PR) Bolt Graphics Achieves Silicon Bring-up of Zeus Test Chip, Opens Taipei Office
triaged.angle: Bolt Graphics brought up its Zeus test chip ahead of a commercial GPU planned for general availability in 2027.

triaged.title: (PR) d-Matrix Announces Squadron Compute Clusters for AI Inference at Data Center Scale
triaged.angle: d-Matrix announced multi-rack inference clusters delivering megawatts of compute for data-center-scale deployments.

triaged.title: (PR) Marvell Unveils Second-generation Structera X, Industry-first Six-channel CXL 3.2 Memory Expanders for AI Inference
triaged.angle: Marvell launched six-channel CXL 3.2 memory expanders for AI inference systems.

triaged.title: (PR) Astera Labs Unveils Orion: A Compute-Agnostic Rack-Scale Architecture
triaged.angle: Astera Labs introduced a modular rack-scale reference design that lets customers choose their GPUs and CPUs.

triaged.title: Microsoft Releases Maia 300 Compute Processor for Azure Cloud
triaged.angle: Microsoft says Maia 300 will scale to multi-gigawatt deployments as Azure’s primary inference processor.

triaged.title: (PR) KIOXIA Introduces Direct Liquid Cooling Support for Enterprise SSDs
triaged.angle: Kioxia added direct-liquid-cooling models to its CM9 enterprise SSD lineup.

triaged.title: GlobalFoundries to Operate Two New Semiconductor Fabs in New York
triaged.angle: A U.S.-Japan initiative of up to $21 billion plans two new fabs at GlobalFoundries’ New York site, with about $10 billion for the first.

triaged.title: (PR) IBM and Siemens Collaborate on Research to Advance Nanostack Architecture
triaged.angle: IBM and Siemens are collaborating on research to advance IBM’s nanostack transistor architecture.

triaged.title: ASML Shipments to China Surge to 23% of System Sales in Q3 2026
triaged.angle: China accounted for 23% of ASML system sales in Q3 2026; the company reported €11.7 billion in revenue.

triaged.title: (PR) Sapphire Officially Unveils NITRO+ AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT Valor Mortis Edition
triaged.angle: Sapphire unveiled a Ghostrunner-themed Radeon RX 9070 XT edition.

triaged.title: (PR) Biostar Introduces the BIWCL-PAT Industrial Motherboard for Edge Computing and AIoT Applications
triaged.angle: Biostar introduced an industrial motherboard based on Intel Core Series 3 processors.

triaged.title: GlobalFoundries Returns to Advanced-Node Race With 7 nm-Class FDX Fusion
triaged.angle: GlobalFoundries announced 7 nm-class FDX Fusion technology, signaling a return to the advanced-node race.

triaged.title: NVIDIA RTX 5080 24 GB Reportedly Planned For Q1 2027, but Board Partners Are Still in the Dark
triaged.angle: An unconfirmed report says NVIDIA may plan a 24 GB RTX 5080 for Q1 2027 amid changes to RTX 5090 chip allocation.
